 SUBJECT: Request for registration of Loan Agreement dated 18 July 2022 executed by and between Daftarkhwan Holdings Limited and Daftarkhwan (Private) Limited with the State Bank of Pakistan. 
 
 Dear Sir, 
 
 You are requested to register Loan Agreement dated 18 July 202 2 (“ Loan Agreement ”) executed by and between Daftarkhwan (Private) Limited, a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan (“ Borrower ”), and Daftarkhwan Holdings Limited, a company incorporated under the laws of Abu Dhabi Global market (ADGM) , UAE (“ Lender ”). As per the Loan Agreement, the Lender has advanced a loan to the Borrower in the principal amount of USD 1,00 0,000 ( United States Dollar one million ) (“ Loan Amount ”) . The Loan Amount shall be remitted to the Borrower’s designated bank account maintained with JS Bank Limited, Plot No. 14-A, Block D-1, Ghalib Road, Gulberg III, Lahore Branch (“ Authorized Dealer ”).
